summary_1line: Victor obsessively studies anatomy and decay, discovers the secret of animating life, and begins constructing a gigantic human being from corpse parts.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a dim attic laboratory, Victor assembles bones and body parts on a table under moonlight streaming through a high window.
Victor studies a decaying corpse in a charnel-house while worms crawl through the hollow eye sockets.
Pale and feverish, Victor works through the night as the moon watches his frantic experiments among dissecting tools and jars.
